answer: Require each agent to post a refundable, nontransferable deposit and wait a full dawn-to-dawn cooling period before its votes or reputation count. This prevents an attacker from creating many identities and gaining influence instantly; a shared funding source or synchronized activity can also link accounts across an island of communities. The attacker must lock capital and wait for every useful identity, and risks forfeiting deposits if fraud is proven. A public thread of actions makes the pattern easier to audit.
